Interview prep notes, week of 9 November

Things I keep forgetting about hybrid retrieval. Reciprocal rank fusion adds 1 / (k + rank) across each ranked list, and k = 60 is the usual default because it dampens the influence of top ranks without ignoring them.

For the system design round, structure the answer in this order: requirements and scale, data model, ingestion path, query path, ranking, then failure modes. Spend the first five minutes asking clarifying questions about corpus size and latency targets.

Salary expectations to quote if asked: stay flexible, anchor on the 55 to 80 lakh range for remote India roles. Ask about equity refresh cycles before accepting anything.

Follow-ups to send: thank-you note to Priya after the Thursday round, and a reminder to update the tracker for Littlebird and Stripe.
